score.scope: Whole-scene still-image craft within Brand A's lens: personal story, hierarchy, identity and cohesion of environment, light and materials. Fresh scope; earlier eye or concept verdicts are not inherited approval.
score.confidence: High on the visible hierarchy and material differences; moderate-high on craft judgment. The cause of the texture change is not established.

deductions.finding: Irregular faceted/crackled surface detail now crosses the foreground moth's cream face, antenna paddles and wing, the bench slats, trunk and parts of the path. Distinct soft and hard materials share a similar etched treatment. It weakens the intended soft-film finish and the moth's innocent tactile appeal.
deductions.location: Most conspicuous in the native hero crop: forehead/cheek, upper paddle, left upper wing and bench back/seat; also visible in full11 and at1280.
deductions.severity: Must fix before calling this whole scene finished

deductions.finding: Bright edging and fine golden detail are active across the canopy, flowers, bench and path. The large hero still leads, but the whole image has less visual rest and material restraint than07; some of the added sparkle reads as surface busyness rather than useful depth.
deductions.location: Canopy rim, bench top edge and middle/lower path, seen at1280 and880.
deductions.severity: Optional lighting/detail refinement, separate from the material defect

criteriaForNine: Restore controlled, material-specific surfaces: soft cream moth and matte paddles; directional timber grain; distinct cloth weave, stone and metal. The irregular network must no longer dominate unrelated surfaces at native and1280 inspection.
Preserve the current three-activity composition, four guests in two subordinate groups, clear bench-only coding lead, improved wing markings and corrected companion eyes while repairing finish.

Keep convincing right-side warmth and depth while letting nonessential edge/detail contrast recede. Judge the complete replacement and matching crops; a repaired eye or a smaller display cannot alone earn9.

strengths: The whole composition now offers a small authored world instead of repeating a wordmark. Coding, building and resting relate through one continuous park and the repeated original moth.
The large foreground coder remains unmistakably dominant at1280,880 and420. Guests occupy two existing secondary areas; none occupies the bench or foreground path.

The tree and canopy frame the left activities; the curved path opens breathing space and connects them with the right bench. Foreground foliage, middle workshop and hazy bridge establish readable depth.

Warm light from the right, cast/contact shading and a cooler distant background broadly support a coherent atmosphere. Cup, books and knitted throw reinforce a settled place to work without private project content.
The tiny cream/lime silhouette, unequal paddles and mitten/stub-foot language remain recognizable.11 makes the green forewing marking clearer than07, which helps continuity with the original.

The leaf game gives the lower-left pair a shared purpose. In the enlarged11 evidence Muse has dark eyes and Grok's two light ovals appear flat and pupil-free; that narrow success does not erase the whole-scene material concern.

mustFix.action: Repair the cross-material faceting/crackle, prioritizing the foreground moth and bench and checking the trunk/path for the same treatment. Use07's quieter material separation as a finish reference while retaining11's intentional story/identity corrections.
mustFix.acceptance: At native and1280, soft face and paddles read as soft forms, timber reads as timber and stone as stone; no single etched texture visually spreads across all of them. Recheck the complete image and crops so cleanup does not erase eyes, markings, contact or detail elsewhere.
mustFix.notRequired: No anatomy redraw, guest removal, extra props, text or composition restart. I do not prescribe a generation technique or claim the exact cause.

optional: Restrain selected edge sparkle and tiny high-contrast foliage/path detail after the material repair, preserving a lively park and warm light. Do not flatten the scene into empty minimalism.

Inspect workshop hand/tool contact at full source size with the articulation specialists; the action is broadly readable to this brand lens, and I am not asserting a separate contact defect from the crop.
baselineComparison: 07 already has the same strong framing and grouping, quieter pale moth surfaces, more restrained wood texture and clearer distinction between soft character, woven throw and bench.11 adds more evident wing marking, a more engaged workshop presentation and corrected pupil-free Grok ovals. Its stronger warm edging and pervasive irregular surface network reduce material polish. I favor retaining11's purposeful changes while recovering07's surface control, not selecting07 wholesale.
